sentences.text: Mr. X & Anr vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 4 February,

2026
04.02.2026 P.M. C.R.R. 375 Of 2026 Mr. X & Anr.
- Vs -
The State of West Bengal & Anr.
Mr. Sekhar Basu, Sr. Adv, Mr. Ranadeb Sengupta, Mr. Sachit Talukdar, Mr. Soumyadip Maity.
...

The present revisional application has been preferred praying for quashing of the proceeding being S.T. 349 of 2025 corresponding to S.C. No. 330 of 2024 arising out of Tamluk Police Station case No. 859 of 2024 dated 01.10.2024 under Sections 64(2)(f)/65(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (corresponding to Sections 376(2)(f)/376AB of the Indian Penal Code, 1860)
and under Sections 6/21 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 presently pending before the learned Judge, Exclusive POCSO Court, Tamluk, Purba Medinipur.
Vide order dated 15th December, 2025 the learned Trial Court being the POCSO Court has been pleased to reject the petitioner's prayer for discharge.
It appears from the record that the accused/petitioners herein are the grandfather and the father of the victim.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The defacto complainant in the present case is the mother of the victim and the wife of the petitioner No. 2 and daughter-in-law of the petitioner No. 1.
It appears that a case under Section 498A of the IPC has also been registered by the defacto complainant against the petitioners herein.
As the offences alleged also involves the offence under POCSO Act, the prayer for stay shall be considered, on service upon the victim/defacto complainant.
Matter be placed before the regular Bench on 13 th February, 2026.
Liberty to pray for stay on service.
